summary: Master building condition assessments, calculate FCI, and develop evidence-based capital renewal plans. Prioritize deferred maintenance with this expert trainin
lede: Building condition assessment and capital renewal planning helps facilities directors and asset planners turn property condition data into investment priorities. Participants learn to assess building systems, calculate condition and replacement-value measures, rank deferred maintenance by risk, and use lifecycle costs to shape multi-year renewal plans and explain funding priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for evaluating infrastructure health, managing deferred maintenance, and allocating capital across property portfolios.
modules: Developing the Multi-Year Capital Renewal Plan
Executive Reporting and Capital Budget Justification
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of facility operations, maintenance management, or property finance. No advanced engineering or coding experience is required, but familiarity with basic spreadsheet functions is necessary for lifecycle cost modeling exercises.
